jointLaunchReview.reason: The joint Essential + Comprehensive launch adds a commercial price-version contract, a Comprehensive engagement lifecycle and a client evidence intake. Each brings new direct service-role table operations, which changes the AST inventory hash and therefore requires this manual privilege review.
jointLaunchReview.principle: Each new table receives the narrowest verb set an actual call site needs. No new table receives DELETE. Both audit tables are INSERT-only by grant AND rejected on UPDATE/DELETE by trigger. product_price_versions is SELECT-only because prices are minted by migration, never by application code.
jointLaunchReview.storageApiReview: Comprehensive evidence and report artifacts use private Storage buckets with server-derived one-object paths. Uploads are followed by immutable metadata RPCs; failed metadata commits compensate the exact uploaded object. No getPublicUrl or createSignedUrl is used in this lane, and no storage credential or path is returned to a browser.
jointLaunchReview.anonAuthenticatedPrivilege: None on any new table. Verified executably, not by inspection, in scripts/joint-launch-migration-replay-tests.mjs against a real Postgres.
jointLaunchReview.securityDefiner: The artifact metadata/release RPCs and the append-only review-record audit trigger are SECURITY DEFINER with an empty search_path; lifecycle, evidence and price helpers remain SECURITY INVOKER with explicit search paths. The migration replay asserts these boundaries.
jointLaunchReview.transactionalClosureReview: Paid-order creation moved into public.create_paid_order(), a SECURITY INVOKER transactional RPC. Comprehensive artifact release is a separate service-role-only atomic set finalisation after all verified metadata and human-review records exist. Direct application INSERTs on public.orders and public.comprehensive_engagements are therefore gone; no customer-facing privilege was widened.
